Cookie Policy

Last updated 13 October 2026

Privacy NoticeWebsite TermsCookie Policy

1. Introduction

This Cookie Policy explains how Go Technologies ("we", "us", or "our") uses cookies and similar technologies on its corporate website at https://gotechnologies.lk.

It describes what cookies are, why they may be used, and how visitors can manage their preferences.

This policy should be read together with our Privacy Notice.

2. What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files that websites may store on your device when you visit them.

They can help websites remember certain preferences, operate securely, measure performance, and understand how visitors interact with content.

Websites may also use similar technologies, including browser storage and analytics identifiers, for related purposes.

3. Types of Cookies We May Use

The cookies used on our website depend on the features and third-party services enabled.

3.1 Strictly Necessary Cookies

These cookies support essential website operations, such as:

  • Security and protection against misuse.
  • Maintaining necessary website functionality.
  • Remembering applicable privacy or cookie preferences.
  • Supporting essential technical operations.

Certain essential technologies may operate without consent where permitted by applicable law.

3.2 Analytics and Performance Cookies

Where enabled, analytics technologies help us understand how visitors interact with the website.

They may collect information such as:

  • Pages viewed and navigation patterns.
  • Approximate visit duration.
  • Browser and device information.
  • General geographic or referral information.
  • Website performance and usage trends.

We may use Google Analytics 4 or another analytics provider for these purposes.

Where required by applicable law, analytics technologies will only be enabled after appropriate consent.

3.3 Functional Cookies

Functional cookies may be used to remember preferences or support optional website features.

Depending on the functionality implemented, these may include language preferences or other user experience settings.

3.4 Marketing Cookies

If marketing or advertising technologies are introduced in the future, they may be used to measure campaign effectiveness or support relevant promotional communications.

Such technologies will be described in this policy and will be subject to applicable consent requirements before being used.

The presence of this section does not mean that marketing cookies are currently active.

4. First-Party and Third-Party Cookies

First-party cookies are set by the website you are visiting.

Third-party cookies may be set by external service providers whose tools or functionality are integrated into the website.

Where applicable, these providers may include website analytics, hosting, security, or embedded-content services.

Third-party providers may process information under their respective privacy policies and contractual arrangements.

5. Cookie Duration

Cookies may be:

Session cookies: Temporary cookies that generally expire when the relevant browser session ends.

Persistent cookies: Cookies that remain on your device for a defined period or until removed.

The actual duration depends on the purpose and configuration of each cookie.

6. Managing Your Cookie Preferences

Where optional cookies requiring consent are used, we will provide an appropriate method for visitors to make their choices.

Where available, you may change or withdraw your consent through the website's cookie preference settings.

You can also manage or delete cookies using your browser settings.

Disabling certain cookies may affect some website features or preferences.

7. Google Analytics

If Google Analytics is enabled, it may be used to understand website visits, traffic sources, user interactions, and general usage patterns.

Information processed through the analytics service may be handled by Google in accordance with its applicable terms and privacy practices.

Where required, analytics consent will be obtained before analytics cookies or related technologies are activated.

For further information about Google's data practices, visit: https://policies.google.com/privacy

8. Changes to This Cookie Policy

We may update this Cookie Policy when website functionality, third-party integrations, or applicable legal requirements change.

The latest version will be published on this website with an updated date.

9. Contact Us
